source_review.detail: Four individually identifiable prose candidates were reviewed from official metadata only: Standard Ebooks Pride and Prejudice and Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (EN), Wolne Lektury Lalka and Pan Tadeusz (PL). All are pending, not acquisition-ready; blockers include EU/Polish rights review, edition/annotation/illustration handling and missing artifact checksums or immutable revisions. No full text, dataset shard, gated access or acquisition occurred. The bounded proposal caps raw UTF-8 at 10 MiB, targets 50/50 EN/PL content tokens, is prose-only and defers 16k/32k tokenizer qualification. No rights approval, source pin or legal opinion is claimed.

limitations: Metadata-only review; no full text, corpus shard, tokenizer artifact or real-data materialization was acquired.
No candidate is acquisition-ready; EU/Polish rights, edition/annotation/illustration handling and checksums/revisions remain open.
Standard Ebooks provides U.S. public-domain warnings, not EU clearance; Wolne Lektury metadata lacks immutable revisions/checksums.
The four-work pilot cannot guarantee 50/50 train/validation/test balance without additional works; the proposal states this imbalance.
The shard loader provides integrity checks for a trusted local single-writer dataset; it is not a rights gate, multi-writer lock or adversarial filesystem guarantee.
The synthetic shard demo is not a production tokenizer, quality, throughput, fertility or downstream model claim.
Cross-platform shard equality is not claimed until a separate Linux comparison verifies the v2 canonical digests.
